results.title: Fellow Ode Gen 2 review
results.content: The Fellow Ode Gen 2 is a flat-burr grinder made for filter coffee.

results.title: Baratza Encore ESP review
results.content: The Baratza Encore ESP is a conical-burr grinder that covers espresso and filter.

http://grinders.example.test/ode.body: <html><body>Fellow Ode Gen 2: 64 mm flat burrs, single-dose, filter only, about 250 euros.</body></html>

http://grinders.example.test/encore.body: <html><body>Baratza Encore ESP: 40 mm conical burrs, espresso and filter, about 180 euros.</body></html>
